records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the third quarter of 2024 totaled $315.8 million, a 3.6% increase as compared to consolidated net sales of $304.7 million in the third quarter of 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024
records.text: Our order backlog was $76.8 million at September 30, 2024 compared to $186.2 million at December 31, 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024
records.text: •Organic sales growth of 2.1% attributed to price realization across all regions and favorable product and channel mix and higher equipment sales in the Americas, partly offset by lower organic sales in the EMEA and APAC regions;

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024
records.text: •Organic sales growth of 2.7% was primarily due to price realization and higher equipment sales in the Americas, partly offset by lower organic sales in the EMEA and APAC regions;

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2024
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities during the nine months ended September 30, 2024 was $52.2 million compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $124.6 million during the nine months ended September 30, 2023.
